Usage: 
%s -n | -f <config-file> [-c <configuration>] [-g <group>] [-l <log-file>] [-t] [-e] [-N <application name>] [-v <level>] [-h]
  -n Run the name server thread only.
  -f Name of the configuration file. If it is not defined then XSAL_INSTANCE_NAME environment variable is used instead.
  -c Configuration id to be started, 0 is default value.
  -p <priority> ProcessManager priority
  -h Shows this info.
  -t, -l, -g, -e, -v and -N are DebugTrace parameters.

It is possible to run your own instance of the ProcessManger.
In order to do it set unique name to the XSAL_INSTANCE_NAME environment variable,
e.g.
export XSAL_INSTANCE_NAME=my_procces_manager
